changelog:
## oracle-x-dev 1.0.2

- Added a README.md file to the repository.
summary: Extend the Oracle-X financial terminal codebase — add or change a FastAPI endpoint, wire a new upstream data source into the health badge, register a blockchain adapter, write a prompt or an LLM-backed note, and test any of it the way this repository tests things. Use whenever work touches backend/routers, backend/services, backend/prompts, backend/tests or frontend/lib in the Oracle-X repo, whenever someone asks how to add a route, a data provider, a chain, a prompt or a note here, and whenever a change is about to be committed and needs to clear the four quality gates. Consult it before writing the first line, because this codebase has conventions — one-service routers, duck-typed chain adapters, prompts as files with literal call sites, monkeypatch at the import site — that a reasonable-looking change will violate silently.
